jobs.occupation: New Connectivity Design Hub Engineer (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Job description

Be a Founding Member of our New Connectivity Design Hub in Manching

Help us build the "Manching Footprint" of Connectivity & Comms. We are looking for a Senior Comms Engineer/Architect/Lead who thrives in "Brand New" environments. Based in our new Manching Design Office, you will take the lead on end-to-end development—from first concept to final qualification of all Connectivity Systems such as Tactical Datalinks (as but not only L-16), Comms Managers, IFDL, IVDL, CCAs C2 links for Air Power products such as Fighters, FCAS, CCAs, MuT, A400M…

Why this is different: This is the birth of our "Manching Team." You have the rare chance to bridge two worlds: the deep, established expertise of our Connectivity domain and the fresh, high-stakes opportunities emerging from new programs in Manching. You aren't just joining a legacy; you are scaling it into a new big team full of professional opportunities.

However, for all that, we need a skilful professional with proven knowledge in (some of) Systems Engineering or Connectivity, Tactical DataLinks, Satcom, Architectures definition, ready to be fully empowered and taking ownership of all Integration and Design Activities always paying attention to the future by means of innovation and R&T.

The Reward: A clear development path in a high-visibility, innovative discipline reporting directly to the HO Domain.

Ready for the challenge?

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Definition and Design of the Connectivity architecture
- Support Customer (German mainly) meetings, Top Level requirements generation
- Alignment with Domain Connectivity Strategy considering National Programs specific requirements
- Suppliers Selection, RFP and RFI generation and analysis together with Procurement
- L1/L2/L3 Requirement definition and validation
- Support interface definition of interfacing systems and equipment
- Ensure requirement traceability and coverage
- Support L2/L3 system test activity

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- Master's degree in Communications/Aerospace-/Software Engineering or comparable studies
- At least 3 years of professional experience
- Experience in Connectivity Systems such as Satcom
- Experience in System Design and Development
- Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, showing a great team spirit
- Fluent in English and German (C1 Level)

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.description:
Job description

In order to support our “Technical Certification Team”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Electronics and/or military Avionics Designated Airworthiness Engineer (d/f/m)

This team provides certification expertise across all Airbus Defence and Space aircraft programs and represents Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead the certification, qualification and Continued Airworthiness activities for the Electronics and/or Military Avionics technical disciplines.
- Provide airworthiness approvals and exercise Design Organisations Approvals (DOA) as well as Military Design Organisation Approvals (MDOA) privileges for the scope of assigned responsibility as delegated by the Office of Chief of Airworthiness.
- Be responsible for the timely achievement of certification and qualification milestones through identification of major program technical issues and associated risk management plan, identification of regulation and interpretation issues and identification of safety and certification compliance issues.
- Lead the necessary activities for the investigation of incidents and accidents for those aspects regarding Airworthiness technical knowledge.
- Provide technical certification knowledge in Electronics and/or Military Avionics to the design organization, or special projects.
- Influence the definition of certification policies for the technical discipline under his/her scope, and promote their consistent application across programs, including the participation in the development of new and foreseen technical certification strategies or policies. In particular for novel or unusual design features or for compliance demonstration method improvement.
- Represent Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups for technical certification.
- Contribute to technical certification de-risking in Airbus Defence and Space Research and Technology (R&T) as well as Research and Development (R&D) projects related to the Airworthiness Technical.
- Gather and disseminate Technical Certification regulatory knowledge and expertise within Airbus Defence and Space, particularly for Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) and Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) community, to maintain state of the art.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering.
- Extensive professional experience (more than 10 years) in Airworthiness functions related to Electronics and/or Military Avionics discipline.
- Experience interfacing with Aviation Authorities is a plus.
- Excellent negotiation skills, strong interpersonal and consulting skills.
- Ability to understand complex issues and break them down in order to develop solutions independently.
- Advanced level of English.
- Good knowledge of German language is a plus.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

System Engineer (d/f/m) in Self Protection System

The need for military helicopters is increasing in the current geopolitical context. Military customers are demanding more and more performance from the active self-protection system. On the other hand, technologies are evolving fast with the introduction of the artificial intelligence. Mastering the Electronic Warfare System is key for the military business.
In this context, your mission will be to manage the development and the integration of new and complex Electronic Warfare Systems (EWS) into militarized helicopters to ensure the protection of the aircraft and the crew.

Your location

- Review integration constraints with the integration team and contribute to the overall helicopter system reviews and assessments
- Define the test requirements on the System Integration Rigs and on the helicopters
- Support the test team during bench and flight tests
- Contribute to the writing of the documentation for certification or qualification

jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 194945

With our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad, we are among the world's leading premium manufacturers of automobiles and motorcycles, while also providing premium financial and mobility services.

Our team is responsible for IT security across the entire ConnectedDrive Offboard Platform. We are a multidisciplinary group of internal software engineers and product owners who develop and operate cybersecurity processes and solutions, while driving IT security governance across the platform.

What awaits you?

- You develop and maintain an agentic AI toolchain for the automated vulnerability assessment of our backend systems.
- You design automated methods for identifying vulnerabilities in source code and backend functionalities using both commercial and open-source AI models.
- By expanding AI-powered analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing workflows, you continuously enhance our security assessment capabilities.
- You integrate new analysis techniques, models, and AI agents into the existing toolchain in a targeted and scalable manner.
- Through the design of intuitive frontends, you enable both security experts and software engineers to easily leverage the capabilities of the toolchain.
- You automate build, deployment, and testing processes using CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
- In addition, you implement closed-loop feedback and learning mechanisms to continuously optimize future analysis cycles.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science or a comparable IT-related field.
- Several years of professional experience in Automotive Cybersecurity.
- Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining agentic AI toolchains using both commercial and open-source technologies.
- Experience in developing or operating complex security toolchains (e.g., static and dynamic code analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing tools).
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker/Kubernetes), as well as CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI).
- Business-fluent German and English language skills.

Are you passionate about advancing agentic AI systems for automated vulnerability assessments and actively shaping the cybersecurity of the ConnectedDrive Offboard Platform? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

What we offer?

- Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow together.
- Wide range of personal and professional development opportunities.
- Attractive, fair and performance-related remuneration.
- High level of job security.
- Annual special payments such as vacation pay, Christmas bonus, and profit sharing.
- Flexible working hours including 6 weeks annual leave and overtime compensation.
- Discounted BMW & MINI conditions.
- Many other benefits at bmw.jobs/benefits

Start date: from now on
Working hours: fulltime

If you apply, the next stages of the recruiting process include online testing and an interview with the hiring manager (either virtual or in person).
